name: Feast Of Purim Or Lots The
overview: The Feast of Purim, established by Mordecai and confirmed by royal authority, commemorates the divine deliverance of the Jewish people from Haman's plot to destroy them. The casting of lots, or 'Pur,' as recorded in Esther 3:7, marked the timing of this decree, which was authorized by King Ahasuerus and carried out through his scribes (Esther 3:12). This feast, observed over two days beginning on the fourteenth of the twelfth month, was solemnly bound by the Jews to remember and celebrate the defeat of their enemy's wicked design.
